step0_classification.evidence: modal-runtime is the core with a fan of three callees (modal-worker, Task engine, modal-daemon) and the source states an anti-parallel pair on the same two boxes: `worker -> runtime` task input + control RPCs and `runtime -> worker` events + management RPCs.
tie_breakers_considered: Density (E=8 edges, N=8 nodes) reads E = N, which would allow flow-chain, but a chain has one relation per node; here the runtime carries four endpoints (three out, one back), so the fan shape outranks density.
No source-named bus with disconnected worlds excludes placement-planes.
The only identifiers are eight component names with no addresses, ports or uncertainty markers, which excludes identity-probe-maps.
No phase order and no per-transition motion: nothing is animated anywhere in the source, so the diagram is static and lifecycle-machines is out (its recipe would demand one dot per transition).
step0_classification.secondary_recipe: None applied as a design driver. The execution/storage tail (engine -> backend -> container, engine -> filesystem -> blobnet) is chain-shaped inside view v2, so v2 borrows the flow-chain rhythm (short single-stage hops, lr) without adding side branches.

known_defects.defect: v1 pair labels share one gutter band (text-to-route pairing must be read off the arrowheads)
known_defects.check_reading: labels: 4/4 placed, 0 on route cells, 0 skipped, 0 ambiguous owners (label_slot reserves each label's band, so no ambiguous-owner count is produced)
known_defects.capture_reading: v1-77x47-frames.txt frame 0 rows 21-22, cols 40-58: `task in + ctrl gRPC` sits on the row of e2's arrowhead (38,21) and `events + mgmt gRPC` one row below it (row 22 col 40), while e1's own lane is the column at (36,21)-(36,22). By cell distance the first label is nearer e2's lane than its own, so a reader who pairs by adjacency would swap the two directions.
known_defects.why_not_fixed: measured attempts: v1a1-check (tb unpinned, 2 ambiguous owners), v1a2-seams-lr (2 crossings + 1 skipped label), v1pair-a1-lr (1 ambiguous owner: the first label lands exactly between two lanes 2 rows apart), v1pair-a2-slots (both slots reserved below both lanes), v1pair-a3-tb-minlen2 (1 label skipped: no free cell in a 28-cell extent). With the two lanes two cells apart and box borders occupying the only free rows above and below, the frozen engine has no side on which to separate them; the per-view attempt budget (3) was already spent on the shipped layout.
known_defects.mitigation: unambiguous direction proof is structural, not textual: the two arrowheads at (37,24) and (38,21) terminate on different boxes at different ports, so which route is which direction is readable even if the two labels are swapped; generation.md states the row-to-edge mapping explicitly.
